scientific_integrity: Proof of the infinite claim uses explicit bounds on binary partitions and support concentration; the finite checker verifies definitions but does not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic exponent along odd indices only; no multiplicative constant or finer expansion. Full general comparison with other self-similar sequences is not established; unindexed equivalent weighted-binary-partition asymptotics remain possible.
title: Sharp relative logarithmic growth of semi-Pell and semi-Fibonacci partition counts
